title: Shaul ben Bidri
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Otzar Yisrael cites this name from Menachot 35b, but Hyman says its author misread the text: it has Rabbi Shmuel bar Bidri. Dikdukei Soferim likewise has no such reading.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The misreading and absence of such a variant are Hyman’s judgments about Otzar Yisrael and Dikdukei Soferim, not a fresh comprehensive search.

The complete Menachot 35b paragraph begins Rav Shmuel bar Bidri reporting Rav; other transmitters are offered as alternatives. Hyman gives Rabbi Shmuel. His diagnosis of Otzar Yisrael’s misreading and his statement that Dikdukei Soferim has no such variant remain his judgments, without a new comprehensive search or printed-edition collation.
